    Splitting the support of a module #

    Let M be a module over a directed algebra whose support is split into two disjoint sets L and R, such that every corner e_y A e_x attached to an arrow from one set to the other acts by zero on e_x M. Corners are generated by arrows (DirData.gen), so by induction along the path order no corner from L to R acts on M (corner_cross_zero); hence the parts of M over L and over R are submodules and M is their direct sum (not_isIndecMod_of_split).
